name: mckee-homes
description: Browse McKee Homes' currently available, publicly priced spec homes in Alberta — compare and filter the inventory, and optionally request follow-up from a McKee Homes sales representative.

capabilities: Browse and compare currently available spec homes
Filter inventory by community, price, and home style
Request follow-up from the sales team
defaultPrompt: Show me McKee Homes' currently available, publicly priced spec homes.
Which communities currently have available McKee spec homes?
interface.longDescription: Find McKee Homes' currently available, publicly priced spec homes in Alberta. Ask what homes are available and in which communities, compare them, and filter by community, city, price range, home style, or size. You can also choose to ask for a follow-up from a McKee Homes sales representative by providing your name, a phone number and/or email, and a short message — always optional and only with your consent. Availability changes as homes are sold or released, and an available listing does not mean the home is finished or move-in ready; confirm details and timing with a representative before deciding.
